def top_k_names_preserve_first_occurrence(records, k):
    indexed = list(enumerate(records))
    indexed.sort(key=lambda pair: (-pair[1][1], pair[0]))
    return [name for _, (name, score) in indexed[:k]]

def key_with_min_value(d):
    min_value = min(d.values())
    candidates = sorted(k for k, v in d.items() if v == min_value)
    return candidates[0]
